children: LD Capital founder JackYi said he had judged 20 days ago that Bitcoin would face strong resistance near 86,000 and that closing long positions around that level would be a better choice. According to Odaily, he said he still expects a bull market and does not plan to short Bitcoin.
JackYi said a bull market does not rise in a straight line and that each pullback may offer a new entry opportunity. He also said traders should cut losses in time and manage risk.

title: LD Capital Founder JackYi Says Bitcoin Faces Resistance Near 86,000
